description: This source file defines a class `CLIInstallPrompter` responsible for managing user prompts related to installing the OpenClaw CLI. It includes methods for checking conditions before prompting, displaying alerts, initiating the installation process asynchronously, and opening settings. Additionally, it contains a private actor `StatusBox` for managing status messages during installation.

classes.name: CLIInstallPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class that manages prompting the user for CLI installation and handles related actions, including displaying alerts and opening settings.

classes.name: StatusBox
classes.description: A private actor used within `CLIInstallPrompter` to safely store and retrieve status messages during CLI installation.

methods.name: checkAndPromptIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks whether conditions warrant prompting the user to install the CLI and presents an alert accordingly.

methods.name: shouldPrompt
methods.description: Determines if conditions are appropriate to show the CLI installation prompt based on onboarding status, connection mode, previous prompts, and installed CLI location.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Performs the CLI installation asynchronously and displays a completion message.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens the application settings to a specified tab.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the application's current version string from the bundle.
